business_summary: Sigmakoki Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides optical component products in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers opto-mechanics/manual stages and holders, which include stages, holders, bases, rods, poles, clamps, and cage systems stages; and optics/coating products, including multi-element optics, mirrors, beam splitters, filters, lenses, prisms, polarizers, laser crystals, nonlinear crystals, substrates, and windows. It also provides motion control application systems comprising automatic positioning devices, optical measurement devices, and software for positioning and measurement; and laser system products, including optical modules, lens units, laser processing systems, laser application system products, etc. In addition, the company offers bio-medical related products, such as micromanipulation systems, motorized stage system for microscopes, core unit for microscopy, and bio and medical devices; and optical application system products consisting of optical fiber alignment systems, optical systems for observation, and contracted and custom-made products. Sigmakoki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Hidaka, Japan.
